description: This Java source file defines a REST controller named AnswerController, providing CRUD operations for Answer entities related to questions in a Spring Boot application. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting answers, using Spring annotations for request mapping, dependency injection, and API documentation.

classes.name: AnswerController
